gap.title: Search: a level space of 4 x 6 complex matrices with zero row sums of dimension 8
gap.statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 6 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∀ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∑ f : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 6, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 360) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 8
